name: Remember the Flowers
source:
Remember the Flowers follows the tale of an amnesiac man.

With memories fleeting,  he wakes up in what seems to be a new world.

The only thing he's certain of is his desire to return home.

The only question is: what has become of it?

[From [url=https://jerichowo.itch.io/remember-the-flowers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《记住花儿》讲述了一个失忆男子的故事。

随着记忆的流逝，他在一个似乎是新世界的地方醒来。

他唯一确定的是他想回家。

唯一的问题是：它变成了什么样子？

[来自[url=https://jerichowo.itch.io/remember-the-flowers]Itch.io[/url]]
